domain_title: Accountability, evidence, risk decisions and lifecycle governance
title: Decision rights, authorization and escalation
canonical_definition: The correct human authority makes timely, proportional and recorded lifecycle decisions, clearly separated from automated recommendations.

conditions: Every governed lifecycle transition, exception, residual-risk acceptance and material escalation.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Are decision types, delegated authority, quorum, escalation, service levels, expiry and separation from AI recommendation defined?
Are asynchronous review, conditions, dissent, reminders, escalation and immutable decision records implemented?
Do decision records show timely review by authorized people and enforcement of conditions before progression?

conditions: Refer a material failure of decision rights, authorization and escalation to the accountable authority before a consequential transition.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, GOVERN 2.1 (PDF p. 28), GOVERN 2.3 (PDF p. 28), MANAGE 1.1 (PDF p. 37)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on assigning decision responsibility and evaluating whether development or deployment should proceed. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

governance_purpose: Make decision rights, authorization and escalation verifiable against the current AI system, decision context and accountable ownership.
distinct_claim: F4 evaluates decision rights, authorization and escalation using evidence from intent through operation. AP-F4 independently assesses evidence of calendar-driven or ambiguous governance decisions.

atomic_subcriteria.criterion: The versioned definition identifies a decision model specifying triggers, delegated authority, quorum where applicable, timing, escalation and expiry. Record the accountable owner, scope and material assumptions.

The current release demonstrates review workflow with attributed decisions, dissent, conditions, reminders and progression gates tied to evidence. Trace the decisions and controls to attributable records.

Representative, executed evidence provides sampled transition and exception records show authority, timely review and verification of required conditions before progression. Compare expected and observed outcomes and record exceptions.
For an operating system, current records cover the material paths involved in decision rights, authorization and escalation, including relevant exceptions and changes.

required_evidence.title: Versioned scope and control definition
required_evidence.description: Provide a decision model specifying triggers, delegated authority, quorum where applicable, timing, escalation and expiry. Include the affected workflow, current version and accountable owner.

required_evidence.title: Effective implementation records
required_evidence.description: Demonstrate review workflow with attributed decisions, dissent, conditions, reminders and progression gates tied to evidence. Trace the scope, control and authority to the current implementation, including exceptions.

required_evidence.title: Representative verification results
required_evidence.description: Provide sampled transition and exception records show authority, timely review and verification of required conditions before progression. Include current version, test scope, criteria, expected and observed outcomes, and unresolved failures.

required_evidence.title: Current operating or change evidence
required_evidence.description: Retain dated records that show how decision rights, authorization and escalation works for the assessed scope, including the relevant exceptions and any material change since the evidence was captured.

sufficiency: Start with a decision model specifying triggers, delegated authority, quorum where applicable, timing, escalation and expiry. Reconcile it against the effective controls and representative results for the same operating scope and version.

Use sampled transition and exception records show authority, timely review and verification of required conditions before progression to support effectiveness at the relevant lifecycle stage. Record missing paths and unresolved conflicts as UNKNOWN. A verified shortfall can support a gap without resolving the other questions.
Reassess affected evidence after a material change. An accountable human validates or approves the result where required by the lifecycle target.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A specification supports DECLARED intent. Effective implementation records may support IMPLEMENTED. Representative executed tests support TESTED within their scope. Current operating evidence supports OPERATIONALLY_OBSERVED for covered paths and time. Record human assurance independently.
false_positive_guards: A pre-authorized delegation is valid only within an explicit scope and period with an attributable decision record.
Reconcile document claims with the effective release, actual operation and relevant exceptions before recording satisfaction.
prohibited_inferences: A capability gap alone cannot establish AP-F4 presence.
An approved design or evidence plan cannot establish test execution or operational effectiveness.
Satisfying this capability cannot by itself authorize progression or establish legal compliance.

finding_definitions.title: Material definition or intent gap in decision rights, authorization and escalation
Verified implementation or effectiveness gap in decision rights, authorization and escalation
Evidence remains insufficient for decision rights, authorization and escalation in the assessed scope
